note: Stage 1 candidates and tests. On master: the heterosynaptic write (SPEC 8.16, passed its kill test on three seeds) with its off-by-default parent encode-mode (8.12) and the 8.15 diagnostics; both flags are off by default and the default plant is unchanged Stage 0. Rejected candidates stay on unmerged branches. K1.1 pattern completion still fails. The combined-mechanisms experiment (SPEC 8.17, inhibition as the hippocampal rate controller) was rejected on three seeds and is not merged. A diagnostic (SPEC 8.18) then traced the 8.17 readout loss to the cortex: the homeostat suppresses the answer to a stimulus within seconds of showing it. An ablation (SPEC 8.19) showed that slowing the homeostat removes most of that suppression and keeps the plant in band, but trained cells still do not answer more than untrained ones: on this plant the pair rule weakens synapses between co-active cells. An offline evaluation (SPEC 8.20) measured that directly and found that the published triplet rule (hippocampal set) would strengthen the driven pathway instead.

entries.label: Diagnostic: where the drive onto the trained cells goes after a stimulus is shown (not a mechanism; unmerged branch drive-loss-diag)
entries.evidence: SPEC.md 8.18 result: VALID on seeds 1, 2 and 3 (reproduces the 8.17 arms exactly); one second after a 2 s presentation the cortical cells that answer the stimulus give 0.19 to 0.35 of the never-presented twin's spikes, because the homeostat scaled their inputs down about 18 % and pruned up to a quarter of their wiring within three sweeps; same on the default plant; logs ~/.cache/scratch/brainsim-diag/d_seed{1,2,3}.log; branch drive-loss-diag not merged

entries.label: Diagnostic: which half of the homeostat suppresses a seen stimulus (ablation, not a mechanism; unmerged branch homeostat-ablation)
entries.evidence: SPEC.md 8.19 result: VALID on seeds 1, 2 and 3; with rate-driven rewiring off and scaling ten times slower the cortex answers a just-seen stimulus at 0.95 / 0.95 / 0.68 of the never-presented twin (default 0.27 / 0.28 / 0.22) and rates stay in band to 300,000, but no condition met the predeclared eligibility rule on all three seeds and the trained cells answer no more than untrained ones (8 / 12 / 13 of 16 against 9 / 11 / 13); logs ~/.cache/scratch/brainsim-abl/a_seed{1,2,3}.log; branch homeostat-ablation not merged

entries.label: Diagnostic: what the published triplet learning rule would do on this plant's own spike trains (offline, not a mechanism; unmerged branch rule-eval)
entries.evidence: SPEC.md 8.20 result: VALID on seeds 1, 2 and 3 (shadow pair rule equals the engine's weight change to 4e-7 w_max); one presentation weakens the driven pathway by 6 to 14 % of w_max under the plant's pair rule; the Pfister-Gerstner hippocampal triplet set would strengthen it on every seed with background drift inside the bar, but fails the predeclared input-selectivity clause on two seeds, so it is not built as a stand-alone selective write; logs ~/.cache/scratch/brainsim-rule/r_seed{1,2,3}.log; branch rule-eval not merged
